Title: Vikram's Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 29 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 25 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Pallavi - 55 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Suresh - 37 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
5. Kavita - 34 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Vikram stands by the road. Pallavi and Kavita stand near him.]

Kavita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vikram rides his motorbike to the market.]

Vikram: "What next?"

[Vikram starts his scooter and rides off.]

Vikram (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Vikram drives the car to the office.]

Vikram: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vikram gets out of the car.]

Vikram: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Vikram starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Pallavi: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Vikram is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Pallavi (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Vikram steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Vikram (gently): "Show me too!"

[Vikram's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Vikram (softly): "That's easy."

[Vikram's car crashes into a pole.]

Pallavi (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[A dog runs in front of Vikram's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Pallavi: "Well done!"

[Vikram loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Vikram: "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Meenakshi stands in the kitchen. Vikram stands near her.]

Vikram: "Let's begin."

[Meenakshi rolls out rotis on the board.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, of course."

[Meenakshi stirs the dal in the pot.]

Vikram (happily): "Meenakshi, look at this."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

Meenakshi: "What a nice place."

[Vikram sips red wine.]

Vikram: "Meenakshi, listen!"

[Vikram drinks a beer.]

Suresh (surprised): "That was such a fun day!"
